summary.text: Ben DeSmidt is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 65 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his current term as beginning on January 6, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Ben DeSmidt earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Chicago in 1995 and a Ph.D. from Columbia University in 2006, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as co-owner of Union Park Tavern and as an associate professor at Carthage College.
DeSmidt has served as a member of the Gateway Technical College board of trustees.
DeSmidt was assigned to the Science, Technology, and AI Committee for the 2025-2026 legislative session.
